name: release-radar
description: Release radar. A pane that shows what is coming in the next release and what shipped in past releases of any GitHub repo, summarized in plain language.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: Optional. A GitHub token with read access to your repos. Leave empty to use the GitHub CLI's login (gh auth login).

extraRepos.title: Extra repos
extraRepos.description: Optional. Comma-separated owner/name repos to always list, e.g. vercel/next.js, facebook/react

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Model that writes the plain-language summaries. Set to 'off' to show the raw change list only.
